title: 第七章 对面的人第八章 修车铺
lines: 沈南枝把手上的货放下，擦了擦手，走出柜台。
店门口站着三个人。
白若溪站在最前面，穿了一件鹅黄色的连衣裙，头发烫了，不再是两根辫子，而是披在肩上，发尾微微卷着，看着确实比在村里时洋气了不少。身后跟着王秀兰，还有一个沈南枝没见过的年轻男人，二十出头，瘦高个，戴着一副金丝眼镜，穿着白衬衫黑裤子，胳膊下夹着一个公文包，看着像个跟班的。
“南枝，好久不见。”白若溪笑着打招呼，声音还是那种软绵绵的调子，好像她们是多年未见的老朋友似的。
沈南枝靠在门框上，没让开，也没请她进去。
“有事？”
白若溪也不恼，往店里看了一眼，目光在货柜和招牌上停了停，笑了一下：“你这家店装修得真不错，比我想象的好多了。在京海混得不错嘛。”
“还行。”
“我本来还想着你要是需要帮忙，我可以帮你引荐几个人，”白若溪捋了捋头发，“现在看来不需要了。”
沈南枝没接话。
白若溪身后的王秀兰插嘴了：“沈南枝，你这是什么态度？白老师大老远从龙城来看你，你就让人站在门口说话？”
沈南枝看了王秀兰一眼：“我没请她来。”
王秀兰被噎了一下，脸涨红了。
白若溪拉了拉王秀兰的袖子，示意她别说了，然后又转向沈南枝，脸上还是那副温温柔柔的表情：“南枝，我知道你对我有误会。我今天来，不是来跟你吵架的。我也是来京海做点小生意，以后咱们就是同行了，互相照应嘛。”
沈南枝心里一动：“你也要在京海开店？”
“已经开了，”白若溪从包里掏出一张名片，递过来，“昨天刚开张。在市中心中山路上，离你这儿骑自行车二十分钟。”
沈南枝接过名片，看了一眼。
白底红字，“若溪饰品”，下面一行小字写着地址和电话。名片的纸张不错，印刷也精致，比她在县城那个“白记”的招牌强多了。看来白若溪这次下了本钱。
“中山路租金不便宜吧？”沈南枝把名片还给她。
白若溪没接，笑了笑：“还行。我有个朋友在那边有关系，拿了个好位置。”
朋友？沈南枝心里冷笑。原书里白若溪在京海确实有关系——她爸以前的学生，现在在京海市政府某个部门当了个小科长。看来她已经联系上那个人了。
“那祝你生意兴隆。”沈南枝说，语气平淡。
白若溪看了她一眼，眼睛里有种说不清的东西，像是试探，又像是挑衅：“南枝，咱们虽然做过一段时间的……亲戚，但现在都是做生意的，和气生财嘛。以后有机会，咱们可以合作。”
沈南枝没再说话，转身回了店里。
白若溪在门口站了一会儿，走了。
桂姨刚才一直在柜台后面假装整理东西，等白若溪走了才出来，皱着眉头说：“她怎么来了？是不是又要搞什么幺蛾子？”
“她在中山路开了家店。”
“中山路？那地方租金贵得很，她哪来的钱？”
沈南枝没回答。原书里白若溪她爸虽然家道中落，但以前当教授的时候攒了点家底，加上白若溪自己在村里也攒了些钱，再跟那个科长的朋友借点，凑个几千块开个店不成问题。
问题是，她为什么非要来京海？龙城县城还不够她折腾的？
答案很明显——她是冲着沈南枝来的。
在县城没斗赢，追到京海来了。
桂姨气得不行：“这个人怎么阴魂不散的？你在哪她就在哪，跟个苍蝇似的。”
沈南枝笑了笑：“让她来。”
桂姨不懂：“你还不急？”
“急什么？”沈南枝把柜台上的饰品重新摆好，“她能把我怎么样？在县城她打价格战，打输了。到了京海，她还能翻出什么新花样？”
content_en:
Shen Nanzhi put down the goods in his hands, wiped his hands, and walked out of the counter.
There were three people standing in front of the store.
Bai Ruoxi stood at the front, wearing a goose-yellow dress. Her hair was permed. It was no longer in two braids, but draped over her shoulders. The ends of her hair were slightly curled. She indeed looked a lot more fashionable than when she was in the village. Behind him was Wang Xiulan, and a young man Shen Nanzhi had never seen before. He was in his early twenties, tall and thin, wearing a pair of gold-rimmed glasses, a white shirt and black trousers, and a briefcase under his arm. He looked like a follower.
"Nanzhi, long time no see." Bai Ruoxi greeted with a smile, her voice still had that soft tone, as if they were old friends who hadn't seen each other for many years.
Shen Nanzhi leaned against the door frame, neither stepping aside nor inviting her in.
"Is something wrong?"
Bai Ruoxi was not annoyed. She glanced into the store, her eyes paused on the containers and signboards, and smiled: "Your store is really well decorated, much better than I thought. You are doing well in Jinghai."
"It's okay."
"I originally thought that if you need help, I can help you introduce a few people," Bai Ruoxi smoothed her hair, "It seems that I don't need it now."
Shen Nanzhi didn't answer.
Wang Xiulan, who was behind Bai Ruoxi, interrupted: "Shen Nanzhi, what's your attitude? Teacher Bai came all the way from Longcheng to see you, and you just let people stand at the door and talk?"
Shen Nanzhi glanced at Wang Xiulan: "I didn't invite her."
Wang Xiulan choked and her face turned red.
Bai Ruoxi pulled Wang Xiulan's sleeve and signaled her to stop talking, then turned to Shen Nanzhi, with the gentle and gentle expression on her face: "Nanzhi, I know you misunderstood me. I didn't come here to quarrel with you today. I also came to Jinghai to do some small business. From now on, we will be traveling together and take care of each other."
Shen Nanzhi's heart moved: "You want to open a store in Jinghai too?"
"It's already open," Bai Ruoxi took out a business card from her bag and handed it over, "It just opened yesterday. It's on Zhongshan Road in the city center, twenty minutes' bike ride away from you."
Shen Nanzhi took the business card and took a look.
The words "Ruoxi Jewelry" were written in red on a white background, and the address and phone number were written in small letters below. The paper of the business card is good and the printing is exquisite. It is much better than the "Baiji" sign she had in the county. It seems that Bai Ruoxi has invested money this time.
"The rent on Zhongshan Road is not cheap, right?" Shen Nanzhi returned the business card to her.
Bai Ruoxi didn't answer and smiled: "It's not bad. I have a friend who has connections there and got a good position."
Friends? Shen Nanzhi sneered in his heart. In the original book, Bai Ruoxi does have connections in Jinghai - her father's former student is now a small section chief in a department of the Jinghai Municipal Government. It seems she has contacted that person.
"Then I wish you a prosperous business." Shen Nanzhi said in a calm tone.
Bai Ruoxi glanced at her, and there was something inexplicable in her eyes, which was like a test or a provocation: "Nanzhi, although we have been... relatives for a while, we are both in business now, and harmony makes money. If there is an opportunity in the future, we can cooperate."
Shen Nanzhi said no more and turned back to the store.
Bai Ruoxi stood at the door for a while and then left.
Aunt Gui had been pretending to tidy things up behind the counter just now. She waited for Bai Ruoxi to leave before coming out. She frowned and said, "Why is she here? Is she trying to do something else?"
"She opened a store on Zhongshan Road."
"Zhongshan Road? The rent there is very expensive. Where does she get the money?"
Shen Nanzhi didn't answer. In the original book, although Bai Ruoxi's father's family was in decline, he had saved some money when he was a professor. In addition, Bai Ruoxi had also saved some money in the village, and borrowed some money from the section chief's friend. It would not be a problem to scrape together a few thousand yuan to open a shop.
The question is, why did she have to come to Jinghai? Is Longcheng County not enough for her?
The answer is obvious - she came for Shen Nanzhi.
I didn't win the fight in the county seat, so I chased him to Jinghai.
Aunt Gui was so angry: "Why does this person linger? She is wherever you are, like a fly."
Shen Nanzhi smiled: "Let her come."
Aunt Gui didn't understand: "Aren't you in a hurry?"
"What's the rush?" Shen Nanzhi rearranged the accessories on the counter, "What can she do to me? She fought a price war in the county and lost. When she gets to Jinghai, what new tricks can she come up with?"
